name: WORLD_POSITION
doc: Position of current froxel cell in world space.

name: OBJECT_POSITION
doc: Position of the center of the current FogVolume in world space.

name: UVW
doc: 3-dimensional UV, used to map a 3D texture to the current FogVolume.

name: SIZE
doc: Size of the current FogVolume when its shape has a size.

name: SDF
doc: Signed distance field to the surface of the FogVolume. Negative if inside volume, positive otherwise.

name: ALBEDO
doc: Output base color value, interacts with light to produce final color. Only written to fog volume if used.

name: DENSITY
doc: Output density value. Can be negative to allow subtracting one volume from another. Density must be used for fog shader to write anything at all.

name: EMISSION
doc: Output emission color value, added to color during light pass to produce final color. Only written to fog volume if used.
